heroSubtitle: Approachable AI wrapped in cozy, tactile softness. Technology that feels like a hug.
heroDescription: For intentional parents in France who want their children aged 3-12 to learn, play, and grow through conversation rather than screens, ZackAI is the AI-powered plush companion that combines the warmth of a stuffed animal with the intelligence of a personal tutor. Unlike Bondu, which locks families into subscriptions, unlike Tonies and Yoto, which offer passive audio playback, and unlike smart speakers, which were never designed for children, ZackAI delivers adaptive, multilingual, conversational learning inside a huggable, screen-free form factor — certified safe under EU regulations, available in five bold colors led by Phantom Purple, and sold at EUR 99 with no subscription ever. ZackAI is not a gadget. It is the friend every curious child deserves.
